messages:
taylor: Heads up — multiple customer p95/p99 spikes since 02:15 UTC. Support ticket #7892 reports tail latency ~3x. :eyes:
sam: Which route/model? any common shard or tenant?
ops-bot: ALERT metrics.kv_cache_miss_rate > 30% shard=s4 region=us-east-1 at 2026-03-17T02:16:12Z
maria: watching dashboards -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv ... topology shows tenant X and Y with high prefix cardinality on s4
lee: repro snippet: run load from one client sending varied header 'x-user-meta' -> you'll see kv_miss explosion
lee: command I used:
```
wrk -t2 -c100 -d60s http://inference.internal/v1/gen -s tests/entropy_header.lua
kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod --tail=200 | grep kv_miss
```
lee: sample log line:
```
[2026-03-17T02:16:01Z] kv_miss key=<prefix:user:12345:xmeta=0x7a> shard=s4 latency=12.4ms
```
taylor: quick diff — recent rollout 3171999000 changed prefix normalization -> we may have inadvertently increased key entropy per prefix.
sam: agree. also saw a change in shard hashing function in that deploy (roundrobin->consistent-hash-v2)
maria: customer repro shows p95 spike aligns with high header entropy windows, kv eviction rate jumps
lee: root cause hypothesis: shard-affinity change + prefix normalization edge-case -> hotset spread across slot buckets causing eviction oscillation and warmup thrash
sam: immediate mitigations:
- revert shard hash change (urgent) OR
- bump cache_size for s4 and neighboring shards
- enable LFU eviction on affected shards (trial)
- schedule prewarm job for top prefixes
- add short-term token bucket throttle for noisy tenants
maria: I'm opening a support-side communication that says we're investigating and applying mitigations, ETA 30m
support-bot: Support ticket #7892 updated: 'Investigating kv cache thrash impacting p95. Engineering applying mitigations.'
lee: I'm increasing cache_size on s4 now: `kubectl apply -f cache-config-s4.yaml` -> patch applied
taylor: Can we rollback 3171999000 to be safe? Sam, do we have a clean rollback plan?
sam: rollback is possible but will cause rebalancing; prefer targeted cache bump + prewarm while we validate rollback impact
lee: started a prewarm job for top-500 prefixes on s4 -> job id prewarm-3172001
maria: I'll produce a repro harness (script + headers) and attach to ticket. we should capture trace spans for kv hit/miss
sam: action items:
- lee -> monitor p95/p99 for s4 and confirm reduction (ongoing)
- maria -> repro harness + traces + upload to ticket (#7892)
- taylor -> coordinate rollback decision if not improved in 20m
- ops-bot -> tag alert and create postmortem placeholder
ops-bot: Created incident record INC-3172002, severity=sev2, tag=kv-thrash-3172
taylor: thanks everyone. keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
